record.question: The factor of safety of a slope is 1.74 for the slope angle of 45°. For which slope angle, the factor of safety will be equal to 1.0 (consider that the cohesion is zero):
record.explanation: With zero cohesion, FoS = tan(phi)/tan(theta). From FoS 1.74 at 45°, phi ≈ arctan(1.74) ≈ 60°, so FoS = 1 near 60°.
